sentences.text: This resulted in rejection of the appellants prayer for bail in anticipation of arrest.
3. The appellant figures as accused in Complaint Case No. 373 of 2023, pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Banka, Bihar.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Banka, Bihar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Cognizance has been taken by the magistrate on 8th September, 2023 for alleged offences committed by the appellant punishable under Sections 323/504/506/493 of the Indian Penal Code, 18601.
4.

We find that the High Court, while dismissing the application of the appellant, was swayed by the fact of the complainants allegation that she conceived upon the appellant establishing physical contact with her by Reason: making a false promise of marriage.
However, cognizance of the offence under Section 376 of the IPC has not been taken by the magistrate.
1 IPC 5.
Having regard to the aforesaid state of affairs, we are inclined to accept the appeal.
6. The impugned order stands set aside.
The appellant shall be released on bail, subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Trial Court.
